title: [Nichibei] Lesson Lists – Archived LA Removes Its Location From Browse Scope Entirely
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case: If a student's only Lesson Allocation covering a given location archives, lessons at that location must disappear from Browse entirely, since the location drops out of locationScopeIds.
preconditions: Student A has exactly one active Lesson Allocation, linked to a Location Course for Location A. Bookable lessons exist at both Location A and Location B; only Location A's lessons currently appear in Browse
steps_actions:
1. "Student A opens Browse/Lesson Lists and confirms only Location A's lessons appear"
2. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "Student A reopens Browse/Lesson Lists"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "Student A reopens Browse/Lesson Lists"
steps_result:
1. "Location A lessons shown; Location B lessons absent"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "No lessons appear at all (Location A dropped out of locationScopeIds, and Student A has no other LA covering Location B)"
4. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "Location A's lessons reappear, exactly as before the archive"
steps_data:
1. "LA Archived_At__c = blank; locationScopeIds = {Location A}"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "locationScopeIds now empty -> Browse shows the empty state"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "locationScopeIds = {Location A} again"

title: [Nichibei] Lesson Lists – "Bookable Only" Toggle – Archived Session Wrongly Excludes a Re-Bookable Lesson (Confirmed Gap)
description: AC-5 - Negative - confirmed gap, not a control case: Code-confirmed inconsistency within getLessonBookingList() itself - isBookedAlready (cls:289) correctly filters Is_Archived__c = FALSE, but the bookableOnly=true exclusion subquery (cls:352) only filters Is_Deleted__c = FALSE, missing the archive filter.
preconditions:
Student A previously had a Student Session on Lesson X, but that session's Lesson Allocation has since archived (Archived_At__c populated), so the session is Is_Archived__c = TRUE
Lesson X is otherwise fully bookable again (Published, Bookable_Flag = TRUE, within deadline, capacity available) via a different, currently-active Lesson Allocation Student A now holds for the same location/course
steps_actions:
1. "Student A opens Browse/Lesson Lists with the 'Bookable Only' toggle OFF"
2. "Student A turns the 'Bookable Only' toggle ON"
3. "Student A checks the Bookable-Only-filtered list"
steps_result:
1. "Lesson X appears, with isBookedAlready = false (correctly excludes the archived old session)"
2. "Per AC-5, Lesson X should still appear, consistent with step 1's correct isBookedAlready = false"
3. "[Confirmed by code] Lesson X is missing from the list - the bookableOnly exclusion subquery at cls:352 treats the archived session as if Student A were still booked, silently dropping the lesson instead of offering it (fail - route to the engineering owner of getLessonBookingList)"
steps_data:
1. "Line 289 subquery correctly filters Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
2. "Expected: Lesson X still shown"
3. "cls:352 lacks Is_Archived__c = FALSE, inconsistent with cls:289 in the same method"

title: [Nichibei] Cancel Booking – Point Refund Still Lands on the Target Point LA Even If Now Archived
description: AC-3 / AC-8 (parity) - Regression - control case: Self-cancelling a booking must still refund points to the correct Point LA even if that LA has since archived between the original booking and the cancellation.
preconditions:
Student A booked Lesson 1, with 2 points deducted from Point LA-B (Remaining went from 5 to 3 pts) at booking time
Point LA-B's Archived_At__c becomes populated (its order group is fully removed) after the booking but before Student A cancels, while the booking itself remains within the cancellation deadline
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff confirms LA-B's Remaining Points = 3 and Archived_At__c is populated, before cancellation"
2. "Student A opens My Lessons, taps Cancel on Lesson 1, and confirms 'Cancel Reservation'"
3. "HQ or CM Staff checks LA-B's Remaining Points and Consumed Points after cancellation"
steps_result:
1. "LA-B is archived but its point balance is unchanged from the booking"
2. "Cancellation is confirmed; the Student Session is removed from Lesson 1"
3. "Remaining Points = 5 (3 + 2 refunded); Consumed Points decremented by 2 - the refund succeeds and lands on LA-B (same Id) despite it being archived"
steps_data:
1. "LA-B Archived_At__c = populated; Remaining = 3"
2. "Student Session deleted"
3. "LA-B Remaining = 5; refund not blocked or misdirected by the archived state"
